candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order POST /v1/orders returns HTTP 500; traces and logs show the 500 originating at the order service, propagating as 502 at the gateway.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side root cause (db-pool, redis, config) not established; only the 500 propagation is observed.

report.explanation: Traces correlate each gateway 502 on /v1/checkout with an order-service 500 on /v1/orders; logs show http_client_request 500 to server_address order. Metrics show checkout 502s and elevated p95. Topology confirms gateway->order dependency. The proximate fault is order returning 500, but the underlying order-side cause is not evidenced.
